# Content Management Skill

## When to Use
- Writing or editing website copy for any page
- Creating blog post templates and content
- Optimizing SEO metadata (titles, descriptions, structured data)
- Migrating and improving content from old it-guru.co.za site
- Writing form labels, help text, and error messages
- Creating legal pages (Terms, Privacy Policy)

## Brand Voice Guide

### Tone
- **Professional** but not stiff — like a trusted IT colleague
- **Approachable** — explain technical concepts simply
- **Confident** — we know IT, we solve problems
- **Empathetic** — we understand business frustrations with tech

### Do's
- Use active voice: "We solve your IT problems" not "IT problems are solved by us"
- Address the reader directly: "your business", "you need"
- Lead with benefits, follow with features
- Use South African English spellings (organisation, colour)
- Include calls to action on every page

### Don'ts
- No jargon without explanation
- No placeholder text ever
- No overpromising ("the best in the world")
- No wall-of-text paragraphs (max 3-4 lines)

## Procedures

### Page Copy Template
```markdown
# [Page Title] — max 60 chars for SEO

[Hero tagline — 8-12 words, action-oriented]
[Supporting paragraph — 2-3 sentences explaining the value]

## [Section Heading]
[2-3 paragraphs or bullet points]
[Include CTA button text]

## [Section Heading]
[Continue pattern...]
```

### SEO Meta Template
```html
<title>[Primary Keyword] | IT-Guru Online — [Supporting phrase]</title>
<meta name="description" content="[150-160 chars with primary keyword in first 50 chars]" />
```

### Blog Post Template
```markdown
# [Title with Primary Keyword]
**Published:** [Date] | **Category:** [Category] | **Read time:** [X] min

[Introduction paragraph — hook the reader, state the problem]

## [Subheading with secondary keyword]
[Content — 200-400 words per section]

## Key Takeaways
- [Bullet point summary]

## Need Help?
[CTA — link to services or contact page]
```

### Content Migration Checklist
1. Read old content from `docs/scraped-content/`
2. Identify reusable content vs. outdated content
3. Rewrite in new brand voice
4. Add SEO optimization
5. Ensure proper heading hierarchy
6. Add internal links to related pages
7. Review for accuracy and completeness
